newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHELSEA DEFENDER BURLEY MOVES TO CELTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHELSEA DEFENDER BURLEY MOVES TO CELTIC.

text.p: Chelsea's Scottish international Craig Burley joined Celtic on Thursday in a 2.5 million pound ($4.2 million) move back home.
The defender, who had wanted to leave Chelsea since he was left out of the winning F.A. Cup final side last May, signed a five-year contract.
"I played 40 games for Chelsea last season and I was very disappointed when I was left out of the team for Wembley," the 25-year-old said.

"I had a good relationship with (manager) Ruud Gullit but there was suddenly a conscious decision to leave me out of the team. I was told I could leave in the summer and I felt it was best to move on."
Burley is keen to make sure of first team soccer in the run-up to the 1998 World Cup finals.
